verses.text: As Jesus came down the mountain, a huge crowd stayed on his heels.
A man with leprosy came up, bowed before Jesus, and said, “Lord, if you’re willing, you can make me clean.”
Jesus reached out and touched him: “I am willing. Be made clean.” Right away, the leprosy was gone.
Jesus told him, “Don’t tell anybody. Go show yourself to the priest and bring the gift Moses commanded, as proof for them.”
When Jesus entered Capernaum, a Roman centurion came to him asking for help.
He said, “Lord, my servant is stuck at home, paralyzed and suffering badly.”
Jesus told him, “I’ll come and heal him.”
The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy to have you under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.”
“I’m under authority too, with soldiers under me. I tell one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; I tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
Jesus was amazed when he heard this. He told the people following him, “I’m telling you the truth: I haven’t found faith this strong anywhere in Israel.”
“Many will come from east and west and sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob at the feast in Heaven’s Kingdom.”
“But the children of the Kingdom will be thrown into outer darkness, where people will weep and grind their teeth.”
Jesus told the centurion, “Go. Let it happen just as you trusted.” His servant was healed that same hour.
When Jesus went to Peter’s house, he saw Peter’s mother-in-law laid up with a fever.
Jesus touched her hand, and the fever left. She got up and served him.
That evening, people brought him many who were troubled by demons. He drove out the spirits with a word and healed everyone who was sick.
This fulfilled what Isaiah the prophet had spoken: “He took our weaknesses and carried our diseases.”
When Jesus saw the crowd gathering around him, he told them to cross to the other side.
A teacher of the Law came up and said, “Teacher, I’ll follow you wherever you go.”
Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to rest his head.”
Another disciple said, “Lord, let me go bury my father first.”
Jesus told him, “Follow me. Let the dead bury their own dead.”
Jesus got into a boat, and his disciples followed him aboard.
Suddenly, a violent storm hit the lake. Waves swamped the boat, but Jesus was asleep. 🌊
The disciples rushed over and woke him: “Lord, save us! We’re going under!”
He said, “Why are you so scared, you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and everything went calm.
The men couldn’t believe it: “What kind of man is this? Even the wind and the sea listen to him!”
When Jesus reached the other side, in the region of the Gergesenes, two men troubled by demons came out from the tombs to meet him. They were so fierce nobody could pass that way.
They shouted, “What do you want with us, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come to torment us before the time?”
A large herd of pigs was feeding a good distance away.
The demons begged him, “If you’re driving us out, let us go into that herd of pigs.”
He told them, “Go.” They came out and entered the pigs. Then the whole herd rushed down the cliff into the sea and drowned.
The people tending the pigs ran into town and told the whole story, including what happened to the men who’d been troubled by demons.
Then the whole city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged him to leave their region.
